hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A switch toggles the bulb at index i and all subsequent bulbs to its right.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: To minimize switch presses to turn all bulbs on, process bulbs sequentially from left to right.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Track the cumulative toggle parity to determine whether the current bulb needs to be pressed.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass checks and toggles bulbs in constant time per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
